scope: Mechanical hardware, router/plasma accessories and consumables only. Metals and controls audited separately.
research_limits: Amazon-first searches attempted; public Amazon product pages lacked reliable current prices; no browser surface was available for destination-specific checkout reads.
Distributor posted prices are goods offers. Null shipping is unknown, not zero.
No shopping carts, orders, external messages or supplier contacts were submitted.
Do not replace whole allowance rows with partial priced subcomponents.

offers.item: M5 x 0.8 DIN 562 thin square nut
offers.compatibility: Current design: receive-check 8 x 8 x 2.7 mm maximum. Rev H: 48 nuts, 36 in the bottom slots holding the nine deck profiles to the crossmembers and 12 in the top slots under the HDPE plates. The model calls A4; confirm this stainless offer grade (A2/18-8 is acceptable for water-based mist coolant). Was 96 for the Rev G panels and spoilboards, 240/260 for the Rev E keyhole anchors.

offers.item: M5 x 12 DIN 7991 class 12.9 flat socket screw
offers.compatibility: Current dimensional fit; retain specified assembly torque, do not raise torque to class 12.9 capability.
offers.superseded_by_rev_g: Rev E keyhole-anchor tie screw. Rev G ties use 72 M5x16 ISO7380 button screws (unpriced, HW-GAP-H06). Kept as dated price evidence only.

offers.item: M5 x 20 DIN 7991 class 12.9 MDF screws
offers.compatibility: Rev G: 24 M5x20 DIN7991 spoilboard screws into top-slot nuts; buy 25 to meet the Nutty minimum order. Square nuts are in N1.
offers.superseded_by_rev_h: Rev G MDF spoilboard screw. Rev H has no MDF; the HDPE plates use 12 M5x12 ISO 4762 A4 screws with 15 mm A4 washers (unpriced, HW-GAP-H08). Kept as dated price evidence only.

offers.item: M8 x 16 DIN 912 class 12.9 socket screws
offers.compatibility: 24 frame/pan plus 16 motion. Standard geometry; retain design torque. Direct product price is higher than stale category $0.194.

offers.item: M8 x 80 DIN 912 class 12.9 beam drawdown screws
offers.compatibility: Rev G: eight M8x80 beam drawdowns through the beam compression sleeves (STD_M8x80_SOCKET x8); buy 10 to meet the Nutty minimum order. Do not increase design torque.
offers.superseded_by_rev_h: Rev G beam drawdown. Rev H uses six M10x80 ISO 4762 A4-70 drawdowns (unpriced, HW-GAP-H07). Kept as dated price evidence only.

offers.item: M5 x 0.8 DIN 934 A2 nuts
offers.compatibility: Superseded candidate. Prefer N16 class 8 steel nuts at $1.44/120. Excluded from basket to avoid duplicate nuts.

offers.item: M5 DIN 7349 steel washer 15 OD x 5.3 ID x 2
offers.compatibility: Exact selected size/material offer; confirm order-level hardness certification per retaining-joint specification. Generic thin fender washer is not equivalent.
offers.superseded_by_rev_g: Rev E retaining washer. Rev G models a 1.5 mm thick 15 mm washer under each M5x16 tie screw; this 2 mm DIN 7349 part would shorten screw engagement, so it is not adopted without a stack check. Kept as dated price evidence only.

offers.item: 40-series M8 T-nut
offers.compatibility: Frozen design fit 22 x 13.7 x 5.9. Generic 2020/3030 T-nuts not substitutes.

offers.item: POS6 four-pack, two right and two left hand
offers.shipping_basis: Advertised free shipping to all US states; 5–10 business days processing. Not checkout confirmation.
offers.compatibility: REDESIGN REQUIRED: ball width 9 versus SKF 6; frozen clevis gap 7. Excluded from current-design cash basket.

offers.item: 65–69 mm dust shoe, 38 mm hose port
offers.shipping_basis: US free shipping only at $50 merchandise threshold; shoe plus $8.99 probe totals $48.98, so does not qualify.
offers.compatibility: Spindle diameter match. Brush/tool extension and bed clearance need mounted check. Hose excluded.

offers.item: Passive wired touch plate
offers.compatibility: Simple plate option; confirm isolation and input wiring in control design. Measure actual plate thickness.

offers.item: Vulcan E71T-GS 0.030 inch flux wire, 2 lb
offers.compatibility: Planning quantity only if owner welder/process supports this wire. Main pan/reservoir are 0.120 inch carbon steel. Four pounds is not a demonstrated weld-consumption total; small stainless accessories may need separate joining consumables.

offers.item: Bauer 4.5 x 1/16 x 7/8 inch type 01 metal cutoff wheel ten-pack
offers.compatibility: Planning quantity; match grinder/arbor/speed. Any required joining/abrasives for small stainless accessories are additional; main pan is carbon steel.

offers.item: Rust-Oleum Clean Metal Primer one quart
offers.compatibility: Bare cleaned steel exterior; coverage quantity remains allowance until exterior area is reconciled. No coating on rail datums or bonding points.

offers.item: Rust-Oleum Gloss Smoke Gray one quart
offers.compatibility: Lower-cost brush/roller finish candidate; smoke gray differs from graphite rendering. Local price/stock and delivery unconfirmed.

offers.item: M6 x 20 socket
offers.compatibility: DIN 912 class 12.9. Keep existing design torque; no increase to preload or rated joint load.

offers.compatibility: DIN 912 class 12.9. Keep existing design torque; no increase to preload or rated joint load. Use eight at 25 mm and shorten eight to 22 mm under head.

offers.compatibility: DIN 912 class 12.9. Keep existing design torque; no increase to preload or rated joint load. Use two spindle pinch screws at 60 mm; shorten four to 55 mm under head.

offers.compatibility: Exact M4x0.7x8 ISO7380 class12.9 standard size and head type; retain original design torque.

offers.item: M5 x 0.8 DIN934 class 8 full nuts
offers.compatibility: Exact steel class 8 replacement for prior conditional A2 offer. Two full nuts per stud; not thin DIN439 jam nuts.

offers.item: M6 x 1 DIN934 class 8 nuts
offers.compatibility: Eight ordinary motion nuts plus three right-hand link nuts; 10 AF x 5 mm.

offers.item: M16 x 2 x 100 DIN933 fully threaded hex bolt, class 10.9 black
offers.compatibility: Exact thread/length/head envelope, stronger bolt than design class 8.8. Retain original lower class 8 nut/joint load and tightening limit; seller recommends class 10 nuts for exploiting full 10.9 bolt capability. Receive-check full thread.

offers.item: M6 x 1 left-hand DIN934 class 8 nut
offers.compatibility: Official drawing confirms class 8, LEFT M6x1, 10 AF x 5 mm; matches frozen nut envelope.

offers.item: M5 x 0.8 shoulder bolt, shoulder diameter 6 x length 20, ISO7379 class 12.9
offers.compatibility: Correct shoulder diameter and length for current SKF clevis. Full 25-piece pack cash price; 19 spares. Current opened page $17.40 supersedes older cached $16.13.

offers.item: M5 x 0.8 x 25 DIN913 flat-point set screw, class 45H
offers.compatibility: DIMENSIONAL CANDIDATE ONLY. Supplier DIN913 page restricts these screws to compression, not tensile loading. Bed retaining studs carry clamp tension: do not adopt this as a qualified retaining stud without a separately rated stud design.
